title: Outdoor Kitchen & Patio Stone Ideas | March 2025 GenStone Projects
description: Explore March 2025 GenStone outdoor kitchen and patio projects. Get backyard stone ideas for entertaining spaces and outdoor upgrades.
text: GenStone Project Highlights – March 2025 Outdoor Kitchen & Patio Projects Amanda Lombard Director March projects marked the start of outdoor season, with homeowners beginning to upgrade patios, outdoor kitchens, and backyard living spaces. These projects show how GenStone helps create durable, finished outdoor areas that are perfect for entertaining and everyday use. It added a lot of character to our patio area.” — Reviewer from export FAQs Ask Away. We've Heard it All. Can GenStone be installed indoors and outdoors? Yes. GenStone panels are designed for both interior and exterior applications. They are commonly used for accent walls, fireplace surrounds, entryways, garages, outdoor kitchens, and exterior facades. Evan Trevenna Senior Project Coordinator Are GenStone panels weather resistant? Yes. GenStone panels are designed to withstand outdoor conditions including rain, snow, and temperature changes, making them suitable for exterior projects. Amanda Lombard Director How long does a typical GenStone project take? Most GenStone projects can be completed in a single afternoon or weekend depending on the size of the space. Because the panels are lightweight and designed to interlock, homeowners can install them much faster than traditional masonry stone. Courtney Mintz Project Coordinator Do I need special tools to install GenStone panels? No special masonry tools are required. Most projects can be completed using common tools like a circular saw, screws, a drill, and a level. The panels are easy to cut and install using standard woodworking tools.
